outcome: Infant morbidity (upper respiratory infection symptoms, vomiting, cough, difficulty breathing)
cohort: A cohort of 4203 Tanzanian infants participating in two micronutrient supplementation trials.
finding: Delayed breastfeeding initiation (more than 1 hour after birth) was associated with an increased risk of several common infectious morbidities in early infancy (first 6 months), but not with mortality or growth failure through 24 months.
